			<div class="et_builder_inner_content et_pb_gutters2">
		<div class="et_pb_with_border et_pb_section et_pb_section_0 et_pb_fullwidth_section et_section_regular" >
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_fullwidth_code et_pb_fullwidth_code_0 covid19  et_pb_text_align_center">
				<div class="et_pb_code_inner"><h3>
  Due to the local fires burning near China Creek, Port Alberni causing unsafe conditions and power outages, we are unable to accept bookings until further notice.
</h3></div>
			</div><section class="et_pb_module et_pb_fullwidth_header et_pb_fullwidth_header_0 et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark et_pb_fullscreen">
				<div class="et_pb_fullwidth_header_container left">

			</section>
			</div><div class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_1 et_pb_with_background et_section_regular" >
				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_0">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et_pb_column_0  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_0  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>Things to do and places to go</h2></div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_2 et_pb_with_background et_section_regular" >
				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_1">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et_pb_column_1  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_1  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>
The Nitinaht Region has been home to the Ditidaht People for over 5,000 years. Come, walk in the footsteps of our ancestors on the epic West Coast Trail, ride the legendary winds of Nitinaht Lake, sit with some of the planet’s oldest and largest trees in Carmanah Walbran and Pacific Rim Parks, and listen to the stories of our people. All of this and more is here in one beautiful, remarkably untouched place. Disconnect from your everyday life and connect with everything. Here @Nitinaht.</p></div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_3 et_pb_with_background et_section_regular" >
				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_2 et_pb_equal_columns et_pb_gutters1">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_3 et_pb_column_2  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_image et_pb_image_0">
				<span class="et_pb_image_wrap "><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="800" height="533" src="https://visitnitinaht.com/wp-content/uploads/things-grid-1.jpg" alt="Nitnaht lake offers a third access point to the West Coast Trail." title="" srcset="https://visitnitinaht.com/wp-content/uploads/things-grid-1.jpg 800w, https://visitnitinaht.com/wp-content/uploads/things-grid-1-300x200.jpg 300w, https://visitnitinaht.com/wp-content/uploads/things-grid-1-768x512.jpg 768w" sizes="(max-width: 800px) 100vw, 800px" class="wp-image-124" /></span>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_2  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h4>West Coast Trail</h4>
<p><strong>The world’s best hike just got even better.</strong></p>
<p>The West Coast Trail is epic on so many levels: gorgeous beaches, cool caves, hidden pocket coves, weird cliffs and a lifetime of memories. And now it’s even easier to get on the trail: we’re a new (third) entry point for West Coast Trail, and we’re offering shorter hikes and comfort camping for “weekend warriors” and more casual adventurers who may not wish to hike all 75 kilometres of the trail.</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_accordion et_pb_accordion_0 toggleindent">
				<div class="et_pb_toggle et_pb_module et_pb_accordion_item et_pb_accordion_item_0  et_pb_toggle_open">
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">Key links</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><ul>
<li><a href="https://visitnitinaht.com/about/">Start your hike with an overnight at Nitinaht Campsite</a></li>
<li><a href="/book-your-cabin">Restful cabin stay</a>. Located in a forested private area of the campground.</li>
<li>Full 75km West Coast Trail: <a href="https://www.pc.gc.ca/en/pn-np/bc/pacificrim/index" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">book your trip through the Parks Canada site</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" src="https://visitnitinaht.com/wp-content/uploads/NitinahtLake-BritishColumbia-NitinahtCampground-KeaMowat-ZenSeekers-5-1024x681.jpeg" width="1024" height="681" alt="" class="wp-image-781 alignnone size-large" srcset="https://visitnitinaht.com/wp-content/uploads/NitinahtLake-BritishColumbia-NitinahtCampground-KeaMowat-ZenSeekers-5-1024x681.jpeg 1024w, https://visitnitinaht.com/wp-content/uploads/NitinahtLake-BritishColumbia-NitinahtCampground-KeaMowat-ZenSeekers-5-980x652.jpeg 980w, https://visitnitinaht.com/wp-content/uploads/NitinahtLake-BritishColumbia-NitinahtCampground-KeaMowat-ZenSeekers-5-480x319.jpeg 480w" sizes="(min-width: 0px) and (max-width: 480px) 480px, (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 980px) 980px, (min-width: 981px) 1024px, 100vw" /></p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_toggle et_pb_module et_pb_accordion_item et_pb_accordion_item_1  et_pb_toggle_close">
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">Videos</h5>

			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_3 et_pb_column_3  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_image et_pb_image_1">
				<span class="et_pb_image_wrap "><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="800" height="533" src="https://visitnitinaht.com/wp-content/uploads/about-grid-2.jpg" alt="" title="" srcset="https://visitnitinaht.com/wp-content/uploads/about-grid-2.jpg 800w, https://visitnitinaht.com/wp-content/uploads/about-grid-2-300x200.jpg 300w, https://visitnitinaht.com/wp-content/uploads/about-grid-2-768x512.jpg 768w" sizes="(max-width: 800px) 100vw, 800px" class="wp-image-87" /></span>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_3  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h4>Nitinaht Lake</h4>
<p><strong>Windriders don’t call this place Mecca for nothing.</strong></p>
<p>The solid truth is the winds at Nitinaht Lake will never let you down. Some call Nitinaht Canada’s largest salt water lake, but really it’s a 20-kilometre ocean fjord with unique geological features that produce remarkably consistent, strong winds. Of course a lake this beautiful is meant to be shared, and kayakers, canoeists and sports fishers create their own amazing stories here too.</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_accordion et_pb_accordion_1 toggleindent">
				<div class="et_pb_toggle et_pb_module et_pb_accordion_item et_pb_accordion_item_2  et_pb_toggle_open">

				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><ul>
<li><strong> Nitinaht Visitor Centre/General Store<br /><a href="tel:12507453999">250-745-3999</a><br /></strong></li>
<li><strong>Nitinaht Lake Motel </strong>located in the Nitinaht Village<br /><a href="12507453844">250-745-3844</a> &#8211; Lucy Edgar, Manager</li>
<li><strong>West Coast Trail 3rd Entrance Orientation Centre</strong><br />Nitinaht Visitor Centre/General Store<br /><a href="tel:12507453203">250-745-3203</a> (May 1-Sept 30)</li>
<li><strong>Windsurf Campsite</strong> Inquiries for campground and cabins<br /><a href="tel:1778817162">778-817-0162</a> (May 1-Sept 30)</li>
</ul></div>

			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_4  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h4>Carmanah/Walbran Park</h4>
<p><strong>Our 1,000 year old trees are waiting to meet you.</strong></p>
<p>Walk through what feels like a wall of mist and a time machine, and you’ll soon find yourself amongst the biggest and best collection of ancient trees anywhere. The Carmanah Walbran Provincial Park and the Pacific Rim National Park are two of the most intact, protected ancient coastal rainforests in the world, and are home to a fantastic number of the oldest, largest and tallest trees any- where, including the Carmanah Giant and the newly discovered Cheewhat Cedar.</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_accordion et_pb_accordion_2 toggleindent">
				<div class="et_pb_toggle et_pb_module et_pb_accordion_item et_pb_accordion_item_4  et_pb_toggle_open">

				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><ul>
<li><a href="http://www.env.gov.bc.ca/bcparks/explore/parkpgs/carmanah/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">BC Parks information</a></li>
<li><a href="http://offtracktravel.ca/a-day-amongst-giants-at-carmanah-walbran-provincial-park/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">A day among the giants</a></li>
</ul></div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div>

				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p><span style="color: #000000;"><strong>Nitinaht Tourism</strong></span></p>
<p>The Nitinaht Region on the west coast of Vancouver Island ls home to some of the most wondrous natural and cultural sights and experiences - all in one beautiful, remarkable, untouched place.</p></div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_4 et_pb_column_6  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">

				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p><span style="color: #000000;"><strong>Nitinaht Entrance West Coast Trail</strong></span></p>
<p>We are home to the new Parks Canada 3rd entrance to the West Coast Trail. Start here for shorter hikes and 'weekend warrior' overnight Comfort Camping.</p></div>
